title: Optimizer
wikitext:
Although not incredibly famous, Optimizer was one of the best QuakeWorld players in the history of the Netherlands. He reached his peak when he won [[Duelmania True Masters]] in [[2004]], but was criticised by many for his use of [[rocket jump script|rocket jump scripts]]. These were not illegal back then but frowned upon by many at the time.

Optimizer unfortunately moved on to Quake 4.
